manifest.name: Gin
manifest.workers: One process; the Go scheduler runs goroutines on GOMAXPROCS threads, which defaults to the 2 available CPUs
manifest.database_layer: GORM 1.31 with gorm.io/driver/postgres 1.6 (pgx 5), one database/sql pool of DB_POOL_SIZE connections
manifest.logging: none (gin.New() without the Logger middleware, GORM logger silent)

phase2.validation: ShouldBindUri, ShouldBindQuery, ShouldBindJSON and ShouldBind with validator tags; the handlers answer 400

csrf.mechanism: net/http.CrossOriginProtection (Check) as middleware of the /form, /login and /me group (Sec-Fetch-Site, then Origin against Host; 403)
